newsitem.title: UK: LME markets barely changed in late trading session.
newsitem.headline: LME markets barely changed in late trading session.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices apparently halted their earlier slide on Tuesday evening having gained a foothold on the kerb.
At 1800 GMT three-months copper was indicated at $2,280/$2,284 up about two dollars from the kerb close after an early high of $2,337.
The choppinness in the flag ship contract which showed up elsewhere in the market earlier was noticeably absent in the evening session.
Zinc added just a dollar to its $1,491 kerb close and aluminiunm was also barely changed from kerb levels at $1,564/$1,567.
